Its 3 gain stages and powerful post-distortion EQ controls deliver a flexible high gain experience that is reminiscent of big hair and pointy guitars. In other words, the Hot-British V9 is a Plexi-in-a-box packed full of harmonics, sustain and balls to the wall distortion. Grab your whammy bar! Plexi-style distortion guitar effects pedal Solid-state update to the Tonebone Hot British tube distortion pedal Drive control dials in everything from subtle grit to scooped-out chunk to sizzling leads Contour control varies your distortion character from fat, warm textures to bright airy tones 2-band EQ, Top End, and Mid Boost switches for sculpting your tone Class A buffer drives pedal chains and longer cable runs Housed in a compact, yet rugged enclosure   Tonebone by Radial Engineering Hot British V9 : Demo by Abel Franco The Tonebone Hot British V9 Radial Engineering Guitar Pedals Overview Email Sugaree Licks any additional Promotional Videos Email Sugaree Licks any additional Settings Videos Email Sugaree Licks any additions or corrections to Artist(s) Used Email Sugaree Licks any additions or corrections to Album(s) On Email Sugaree Licks any additions or corrections to Awards Curated by: Deadicated « Korg | G4 Toneworks Speaker Simulator » Wampler | Plexi-Drive Deluxe V2 Overdrive Back To Top Sugaree Licks About Us Special thanks to: Gianca at FA Chords for amazing chord images Contact Us at Shawn@SugareeLicks.com © Sugaree Licks 2026 Website Design & Hosting by AO Johnson Design
